messages:
Ravi Patel: FYI starting intake for helix-30b-qf. Scope: quant experiments, prompt/chat templates + tool-calling schema, benchmark plan vs titan-13b baseline. Product asked to prioritize.

Jess Liu: Draft checklist: 1) quick smoke eval (LLM-eval harness) 2) perf baseline (p50/p95, tok/s) 3) 120-case quality regression set 4) tool-call + structured-output examples 5) canary rollout + fallback.

Samir K: Question: target latency SLO for helix? Hosted API vs Dedicated will change quant strategy.

Angela K: Hosted first. Target p50 token latency <120ms for low-latency tier. Dedicated can be laxer.

Ravi Patel: Hosted then. Start with int8 (weights) + fp16 activations, then int4/groupwise if acceptable. Owners: @Jess for eval sets, @Samir for perf runs, @Angela for quant experiments.

Jess Liu: I'll assemble the 120-case regression set (search/QA/tooling mix) by EOD tomorrow and include negative tests where model returns free text.

Samir K: I'll run titan-13b baseline on current infra and capture p50/p95 and tokens/sec with batch sizes [1,4,8]. Will attach perf traces.

Angela K: Quant plan: run two variants — A) 8-bit weight quant (activation fp16) B) 4-bit group-wise + outlier handling. Record token-level perplexity, NLL, and our `json-valid` metric on regression set.

Ravi Patel: Important: prompt format must support tool calling for a tiny function `get_user_profile(user_id)` and assistant must emit structured JSON only (for downstream parsers).

Jess Liu: Proposed chat + function signature (sample):
```
System: You are a helpful assistant. When asked to fetch a profile, reply only with valid JSON structured as: {"profile": {"name": "...", "joined_iso": "YYYY-MM-DD", "tags": ["..."]}}
User: "Fetch profile for user 12345"
Assistant -> function: get_user_profile({"user_id": "12345"})
Function response: {"name": "Alex", "joined": "2023-09-01", "tags": ["enterprise","trial"]}
Assistant final: {"profile": {"name": "Alex", "joined_iso": "2023-09-01", "tags": ["enterprise","trial"]}}
```

Samir K: Can we standardize keys to avoid synonyms? e.g., always `profile.name`, `profile.joined_iso`, `profile.tags[]`. That helps downstream parsers.

Jess Liu: Yes — regression set will expect `joined_iso`. Will also include tests where model emits trailing comments or plaintext to catch failures.

eval-bot: smoke eval run (helix-30b-qf fp16): quality pass 87% (json-valid 92%), avg tokens 14, latency p50=130ms p95=290ms. titan-13b baseline: p50=95ms p95=220ms. run_id=r-1977654321-1

Angela K: Good to have baseline. Queueing int8 run now — logging `json-valid`, NLL, and token perplexity deltas.

Ravi Patel: Decision criteria proposal: promote to canary if json-valid >=90% AND quality metrics (F1/NLL/regression) within 5% of titan-13b. Canary must have automatic fallback to titan.

Jess Liu: Noted. I'll publish the prompt templates, function examples, and expected outputs in the model intake doc with the eval run ID.

Samir K: Perf runs scheduled tomorrow morning. I'll attach flamegraphs, per-op GPU utilization, and batch-scaling curves.

Ravi Patel: Thanks team. Next sync Friday. If anyone needs snippets for the eval harness or the function stubs, ping me. :thumbsup:
